cat > skew_comparison.sql << 'EOF'
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW training_data AS
SELECT * FROM csv."`dbfs:/Volumes/workspace/mlpab758caf/skew_detection/training_sample.csv`"
;

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW serving_data AS
SELECT * FROM csv."`dbfs:/Volumes/workspace/mlpab758caf/skew_detection/serving_log.csv`"
;

WITH training_stats AS (
  SELECT
    'f1' AS feature,
    AVG(f1) AS mean,
    STDDEV(f1) AS stddev,
    MIN(f1) AS min,
    MAX(f1) AS max
  FROM training_data
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'f2' AS feature,
    AVG(f2) AS mean,
    STDDEV(f2) AS stddev,
    MIN(f2) AS min,
    MAX(f2) AS max
  FROM training_data
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'f3' AS feature,
    AVG(f3) AS mean,
    STDDEV(f3) AS stddev,
    MIN(f3) AS min,
    MAX(f3) AS max
  FROM training_data
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'f4' AS feature,
    AVG(f4) AS mean,
    STDDEV(f4) AS stddev,
    MIN(f4) AS min,
    MAX(f4) AS max
  FROM training_data
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'f5' AS feature,
    AVG(f5) AS mean,
    STDDEV(f5) AS stddev,
    MIN(f5) AS min,
    MAX(f5) AS max
  FROM training_data
),
serving_stats AS (
  SELECT
    'f1' AS feature,
    AVG(f1) AS mean,
    STDDEV(f1) AS stddev,
    MIN(f1) AS min,
    MAX(f1) AS max
  FROM serving_data
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'f2' AS feature,
    AVG(f2) AS mean,
    STDDEV(f2) AS stddev,
    MIN(f2) AS min,
    MAX(f2) AS max
  FROM serving_data
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'f3' AS feature,
    AVG(f3) AS mean,
    STDDEV(f3) AS stddev,
    MIN(f3) AS min,
    MAX(f3) AS max
  FROM serving_data
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'f4' AS feature,
    AVG(f4) AS mean,
    STDDEV(f4) AS stddev,
    MIN(f4) AS min,
    MAX(f4) AS max
  FROM serving_data
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'f5' AS feature,
    AVG(f5) AS mean,
    STDDEV(f5) AS stddev,
    MIN(f5) AS min,
    MAX(f5) AS max
  FROM serving_data
)
SELECT
  t.feature,
  t.mean AS training_mean,
  s.mean AS serving_mean,
  t.stddev AS training_stddev,
  s.stddev AS serving_stddev,
  t.min AS training_min,
  s.min AS serving_min,
  t.max AS training_max,
  s.max AS serving_max,
  ABS(t.mean - s.mean) AS mean_diff,
  ABS(t.stddev - s.stddev) AS stddev_diff
FROM training_stats t
JOIN serving_stats s ON t.feature = s.feature
ORDER BY mean_diff DESC;
EOF
